item.description:
New

  • Apple M5 support: Super cores show as S-CPU next to E-CPU, and M5 Pro/Max Performance cores as P-CPU.
  • Early support for M6 with all three CPU tiers (E, P, S).
  • Dot-matrix graphs.
  • New app icon built for the macOS 26 and 27 look, with dark and tinted variants.

Improved

  • CPU core detection reads the system directly instead of parsing system_profiler, whose format changed in macOS 26 and 27.
  • Matching corner radius on graphs, hover readouts, buttons, and the error banner.
  • A Mac whose GPU frequency table can't be read now still starts sampling.

Known issues

  • On macOS 27, CPU and ANE power read 0 W. GPU and system power are unaffected.

New

  • Automatic updates (Settings → Check for Updates).
  • Top processes: expand the CPU and Memory headers to see the heaviest processes.
  • High-usage notifications for CPU, memory, and power, toggleable in Settings.
  • Settings section with notifications and launch-at-login.
  • Wi-Fi network name and interface in the Network section.
  • JetBrains Mono across the UI.

Improved

  • Popover reworked into one scrollable vertical layout.
  • More resilient sampling: a failed read shows a banner with Retry.

Fixed

  • Memory process list was missing most processes.
  • Swap usage percentage when total swap is under 1 GB.
  • Invisible chart hover readout pill.
